# Medicare — Request for Reopening

**Use when:** a Medicare claim is past the 120-day redetermination window but within
**1 year** of the initial determination. Reopenings address clerical errors and
minor omissions. A true reopening is discretionary — if the issue is substantive,
request a redetermination with a good-cause statement instead.

**NY MAC:** National Government Services (NGS). Submit via NGS Connex or mail.
**Timely filing (original claim):** 1 calendar year from date of service.
